primitives.name: Clear-Space Geometric Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Clear-space rule Treat the mark's outer ring as `1x`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x': 'dimensionless scaling factor', 'r': 'outer ring radius of logo mark'}
primitives.assumptions: Logo elements must maintain minimum separation distances defined by 1x and 0.5x rules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When clearspace < 1x, visual coherence fails; when < 0.5x, wordmark separation violates design integrity.

layer2.mapping: Geometric clearance defines topological embedding of logo components into visual space. GSI infers semantic fidelity from clearance compliance. GSE transitions between mark/lockup states using clearance thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Distance between mark and surrounding content relative to 1x scale

primitives.name: Color Inheritance Semantics
primitives.verbatim_quote: | Both are vector and inherit `currentColor`, so they can be tinted bone, signal, or ink as needed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'color state vector in RGB/CMYK', 'currentColor': 'dynamic color context inherited from parent element'}
primitives.assumptions: All logo variants share common color inheritance mechanism via CSS context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When color deviates from currentColor, semantic alignment with brand context is lost.

layer2.mapping: Color inheritance enables dynamic branding within fixed geometry. GSI models brand consistency as color-state entropy. GSE applies color transformations under currentColor constraint.
layer2.telemetry: Deviation of applied color from currentColor context

primitives.name: Visual Coherence Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Don't - Don't recolor the wordmark to a different family.
primitives.assumptions: Font and color consistency preserves logo identity across contexts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Font-family mismatch or color variance triggers perceptual dissonance.

layer2.mapping: Font and color uniformity define visual coherence kernel. GSI evaluates coherence via font-family and color-state invariance. GSE enforces coherence during layout transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Font-family and color-state variance from baseline
